description: Overview: EXIDE Invamaster IMTT1500 is a 12V 150Ah tall tubular inverter battery designed to deliver reliable power backup for homes, offices and small businesses. Performance & Capacity: With its 150Ah (C20) capacity, it supports multiple appliances such as fans, LED lights, televisions and routers for extended backup duration when paired with a suitable inverter. Technology / Features: Advanced tall tubular plate construction enhances deep‑cycle performance and charge acceptance, while a robust polypropylene container and corrosion‑resistant grid are built to handle frequent power cuts. Ideal Usage Scenario: Ideal for regions with long and frequent outages, the Invamaster IMTT1500 is suitable for inverter applications where stable backup and consistent performance are required throughout the year. Durability & Safety: Backed by a 60‑month warranty (36 months free replacement + 24 months pro‑rata, as per Exide’s terms), the battery is engineered for long service life when installed correctly, maintained with proper electrolyte levels and used with a compatible inverter and charging system.
